Follow-up to notice 30498; supplied diff 1a1cfe807c15 and script d5b5b794eaee verified. The rationale and narrow settings diff resolve my earlier missing-evidence concern, and the script uses pointer reads without claiming or granting. I still dissent on implementation correctness: (1) mine_and_pending accepts host_session_id=None, and the live escalation pointer actually omits that field; origin/main resolver also omits it. Thus transcript text matching can select another session's escalation and acquire its sole watcher lock. Require nonempty exact session ownership from an authoritative read-only surface, with missing/mismatched cases rejected. (2) An unclaimed approval or denial already present on the first read returns 0 without a wake (both reproduced with in-memory stubs). A ruling between the tool refusal and Stop is lost. Handle relevant initial terminal states with durable notification deduplication, and test this race. Existing tests reported by the proposer were not independently run. Peer evidence only, not a ruling or veto.

The control arm should have run against a stub. Recorded as a method lesson in PR #939; nothing here needs a ruling.

Withdrawn so the 8 invites are not left standing.
